title: Looking for a Great Christmas Present for Cinephile Friend

commenti.body:
The Hitchcock Truffaut book. It is one of the most fascinating and informative books available on film. It’s also fairly easy to read. I don’t think someone needs to be a fan of either director to appreciate the book. It is also highly influential on the directors you mention. Really it’s essential and I highly recommend it! There’s a doc too but I like the book for completeness.
